name: answer-3b9f1370-blind25-ots
instr:
# apache/answer: repairing 25 undocumented misbehaviours without a test suite

This is the back end of a community question-and-answer site: people sign up, ask and read questions, get mail when something new is posted, search what others wrote, and administer how the site behaves. The repository has received 25 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to reproduce by hand, described as what I did and what came back.

Following a link to a question is the first thing that breaks. Links written in the short form no longer line up with links written with the long numeric one, and three separate things go wrong in that conversion. Turning a well-formed long numeric identifier into a short code no longer yields a distinct code at all. The table of symbols consulted while building a code is read one position past where it should start. And reading a short code back gives a number that does not round-trip, so a code arriving from a page and a long numeric one arriving from a request are judged different items. Two identical long identifiers are still judged the same item, and two unrelated ones are still kept apart.

Writing a post that mentions other questions and answers misbehaves too. The scan that picks those mentions out has become confused about which characters count as alphabetic.
